reason: Initial baseline run with starter prompt and tool declarations

author: Trần Quang Trọng
reason: Added clearer routing rules in system_prompt.md and synced tools.yaml so base eval tools plus source-inspection/group tools are declared together.
hypothesis: The changes should reduce guessing, preserve base-eval tool availability, and improve routing versus v0. The run improved case_accuracy from 0.65 to 0.85; remaining failures are R03 and R13 using query='tin tức AI' instead of 'AI', plus R12 using clarify(text) instead of clarify(yes_no) for Telegram confirmation.

author: Trần Quang Trọng
reason: Added lookup argument conventions so query keeps only the core subject and news/recency words move to topic/timeframe; strengthened clarify/send boundary wording in both prompt and tools.yaml.
hypothesis: This should fix R03/R13 where the model used query='tin tức AI' instead of 'AI' and should push send/post requests toward clarify(yes_no). Result: case_accuracy improved from 0.85 to 0.95 and argument_accuracy from 0.85 to 0.95. R03/R13 passed; R12 still fails because the model asks for missing Telegram content with clarify(text) instead of confirming yes/no.

author: Minh
reason: Prompt side (mine): promoted the send/post/publish rule to its own section, added the reframe that you do not need the content in order to ask permission, told the agent to treat a vague pointer like 'bản tin này' as something the user will supply rather than missing info, and gave a worked example of the correct and the incorrect first call. Tools side (tool owner): the same yes_no-before-content rule added to the clarify description and its response_type field. Copied forward from the prompt v2 actually measured (7698ce5abe4e), not from versions/v2/system_prompt.md, which was never run. 16 insertions and 1 deletion; the deleted line is the old confirmation paragraph, kept and expanded inside the new section.
hypothesis: R12 survived v2 because the agent still treated the missing newsletter text as information to collect, so an explicit worked example plus the authorisation-not-content reframe should force clarify(yes_no) as the first call. Result: R12 passes with exactly the intended call, and every other case held - 20/20, case_accuracy 1.00, routing 1.00, args 1.00, multiturn 1.00, 20 measured, 0 provider errors. CAVEAT 1: both artifacts changed in v3 and both target R12, so the fix cannot be attributed to the prompt alone. CAVEAT 2: single run. Two byte-identical v1 runs earlier disagreed on M06, so the noise floor is about 1 case; 1.00 here should be read as 0.95-1.00 until replicated. Run used explicit --system-prompt/--tools paths against versions/v3, unlike v0-v2 which used the live artifacts. Hashes are CRLF (Windows); LF equivalents are 886c6165508e and 0c15f88272ad.
